# SafetyTech Academy

> The world's first IOSH-approved Safety 4.0 certification programme — training EHS professionals in AI, SafetyTech, IoT and digital safety leadership.

SafetyTech Academy helps safety leaders modernise workplace safety with AI, data and digital tools. We deliver three learning paths: self-paced eLearning (£497), a 4-week live Accelerator cohort (£997 + VAT), and bespoke In-Company training for teams. All certifications are IOSH-approved and CPD-accredited.

- [IOSH-approved Safety 4.0](/elearning): Self-paced IOSH-approved Safety 4.0 course, 10 modules, 8+ CPD hours.

- [Accelerator Cohort](/accelerator): 4-week live group programme; next cohort 2–30 June 2026.
- [Enrol](/enrol): Apply for the Accelerator cohort.
- [In-Company Training](/in-company): Bespoke training for organisations and teams.

- [Scorecard](/scorecard): Free Safety 4.0 maturity assessment for safety leaders.
